challenges.note: Every challenge teaches a verification skill. The game IS the training. The fun IS the defense against misinformation.

items.answer_hint: Check the actual book spines. Library of Congress catalog. ISBN records.
items.reward: You just learned to check original documents instead of trusting memory.

items.challenge: 'Luke, I am your father' — is that the actual line?
items.answer_hint: The original 1980 script. The actual film audio. Quote databases.
items.reward: You just learned that the most famous quotes are often misquoted. Check the source.

items.challenge: Mandela Effect — affect or effect? And when did Mandela actually die?
items.answer_hint: Effect (noun, the phenomenon). Affect (verb, to influence). Mandela died Dec 5, 2013 — free, age 95.
items.reward: The joke IS the lesson. Check your spelling AND your facts.

items.challenge: Is it 'Mirror mirror on the wall' or 'Magic mirror on the wall'?
items.answer_hint: Watch the actual 1937 Disney film. Read the original Grimm tale (1812).
items.reward: Disney changed it. Grimm wrote something else. The 'original' depends on which original.

items.challenge: Fruit of the Loom — was there ever a cornucopia in the logo?
items.answer_hint: Check the US trademark registration. Archived logos. Company statements.
items.reward: You just searched a federal trademark database. That skill works for investigating companies too.

items.challenge: Where did 'vaccines cause autism' start? Who was patient zero?
items.answer_hint: Andrew Wakefield. Lancet 1998. Retracted 2010. GMC struck him off. 12 co-authors retracted.
items.reward: You just learned to check retraction databases. Every fraud leaves a paper trail.

items.challenge: Who first claimed the 2020 election was stolen? When? Where?
items.answer_hint: Timeline of claims vs timeline of counts. Court filings (62 cases). Judges' rulings.
items.reward: 62 court cases. 62 rulings. The court record IS the fact check.

items.challenge: 'Eating cats and dogs in Springfield' — where did this start?
items.answer_hint: Social media post timestamp. Local police reports. City council records. News timeline.
items.skill: Social media forensics + official record cross-reference
items.reward: You just learned that claims can be checked against police reports in 30 seconds.

items.challenge: The 'MSG is bad for you' myth — who started it and when?
items.answer_hint: Robert Ho Man Kwok, 1968 letter to NEJM. 'Chinese Restaurant Syndrome.' Subsequent studies found no effect.
items.reward: A single letter to a journal in 1968 created 56 years of fear. One letter. Check the source.

items.challenge: Brian Roderick Banks — does he have a teaching credential in Michigan? Go.
items.reward: 15 seconds. One search. The answer is in public records. THIS is how the investigation works.

items.challenge: Is Purpose Charter Academy in the bottom 3% of Michigan schools? Prove it.
items.answer_hint: mischooldata.org → search school → proficiency rates. 3% math. 12% reading.
items.reward: Public data. Free. No FOIA needed. The numbers don't require endorsement to be true.

items.challenge: Does Mark Zuckerberg own property in Kauai? How much land?
items.answer_hint: Hawaii county property records. Public. 1,400 acres. Court filings about access disputes.
items.reward: Property records are public. Every billionaire's land holdings are a search away.

items.challenge: How many LARA filings does Brian Banks have? Name them.
items.answer_hint: LARA business search. Purpose Group LLC, Empowerment Education, PCA, etc.
items.reward: LARA is Michigan's business registry. Every LLC, every filing, every agent. Public. Free.

items.challenge: Clone the repo. Find a node that's wrong. Open an issue.
items.reward: You just peer-reviewed a 12,696-node investigation. Your correction makes it stronger.

items.challenge: The graph says the sort ratio is 0.3949. Is that closer to 1/pi or 1/e? Does it matter?
items.answer_hint: 1/pi = 0.3183, 1/e = 0.3679. Current ratio 0.3949 is above both. Does the target matter, or does the approach?
items.reward: You just thought about whether the target or the journey matters more. That IS the irrational remainder.

items.challenge: The squirrel says 'HD 48265 c' is unclassified. What is it? Tell the squirrel.
items.answer_hint: Search any astronomy database. Is it a star? A planet? A catalog number?
items.reward: You just taught the squirrel something. The bounty board got smaller. You're k-n Gen now.
